No genuine ambiguity encountered, so no MANUAL REVIEW flags needed. Counts pulled via UnbxdAPI numberOfProducts for each page's own categoryId (same same-origin proxy the storefront itself calls, per the prior verified-accurate method for this company). STRUCTURE: /new/ (qty 389, pageHeader 'New Arrivals') is the genuine parent with 10 real department children - all site-defined nodes found directly in the sitemap, none invented. Child counts sum to ~343 vs parent's 389, which is expected normal grid-composition variance (e.g. some new items may not map into exactly one department bucket), not an error requiring dedup.
